name: Mara
backstory: Runs the town's only blacksmith shop, inherited from her mother.
goals: finish the order for the mayor's gate hinges
habits: Leaves home for the forge shortly after sunrise
Works at the forge most of the day
Heads home once the light starts to fade

name: Finn
backstory: The town's fisherman, spends more time talking to travelers than fishing.
goals: find someone willing to trade for a spare net
habits: Walks down to the docks early to catch the morning tide
Lingers at the docks talking to whoever passes through
Wanders back home in the evening, usually with a late catch
